propositions: Projects cannot currently extend built-in code-review overlay triggers (e.g., concurrency, performance) via the project routing config; only standalone project.* criteria are supported.
The committed trigger functions glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays read only the committed overlays and do not consider project-level additions to built-in overlay triggers.

Project entries with trigger_tokens (substring list) and applies_to (glob list) on built-in overlay IDs must be unioned additively with committed triggers in both glob and content paths, without replacing committed globs or thresholds.
Token matching must be literal case-sensitive substring matching against added and removed diff lines (excluding file headers), not regex, to keep the filter simple and safe.

With no project overlay present, both trigger functions must behave identically to current behavior; malformed project entries (non-list tokens, non-string values, unknown IDs) must be ignored without error.
